bug_semantics: TypedObjectAccessor.TrySetValue (and TrySetItem) reflectively writes live CLR members after preparing the member map from public getters only. The write path called PropertyInfo.SetValue / FieldInfo.SetValue with no GetSetMethod(nonPublic:false) or IsExternalInit check, so templates can overwrite private/internal/init-only setters and public-setter properties on the host object.
flaw_origin: Root commit 46054810b50b03a6d19cd51886321cbbefa5d589 created src/Textamina.Scriban/Runtime/TypedMemberAccessor.cs with TrySetValue that looks up a public-getter member and immediately SetValue's it. Later moves/refactors (namespace/path splits, TrySetValue return-value change, indexers, ToObject conversion, nullable) kept that unguarded write; they did not first-write the missing setter-visibility check.
